email.subject: Cool Breeze Works: two things costing you calls
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Cool Breeze Works' site. Two issues likely cost you real jobs: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most of your HVAC searches (usually done on a phone) load broken or slow and people bounce. And there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors who are ready to call have to copy a number instead of tapping it — many just won't bother.

Also no customer reviews on the page, which matters for trust in an emergency-repair business.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
